body: Mickey Factz shines the spotlight on West Philadelphia rapper Animal Kub as the Lyricist of the Week. Animal Kub went viral after his verse on The Punchline Academy freestyle on Shade 45, where he traded bars with fellow Philly rappers including Freeway.
